summary: A Yes vote increases the City of Piedmont's real property transfer tax from $13.00 to $17.50 per $1,000 of consideration, raising about $1.5 million annually for general city services until ended by voters.

tax.text: The Piedmont Beautification Foundation unanimously endorsed Measure GG and recommended voting yes on the transfer-tax increase to fund city needs.
tax.quote: The Trustees unanimously voted that PBF endorse the measure and recommend a YES vote on November 3.
